messages:
marta: Quick sync — preparing outbound to ~40 affected tenants (APAC-heavy) about an ingestion backlog that started 2026-03-18. Draft below. Also proposing a live troubleshoot session tomorrow 10:00 SGT / 02:00 UTC. Thoughts?

olivia: Thanks — saw the incident note. Do we have an approved credit policy per tenant? A few of these are on enterprise annual agreements.

aj: Suggest 1 day pro-rata credit + offer a 1:1 enablement session for high-touch accounts. cc @james-legal for sign-off.

james-legal: Legal OK on a standard mitigation offer. Prefer neutral language: avoid admitting root cause. Use wording like "intermittent ingestion delays" and offer credit as a goodwill gesture. Keep amounts capped (1 day or 5% min).

marta: Updated draft below per legal and shorter subject line. Also linked the triage doc: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-INF-2231 (internal).

```
Subject: Brief update: ingestion delays impacting document syncs

Hi [Name],

We’re reaching out to let you know we experienced intermittent ingestion delays that may have affected recent document syncs for your account. Our engineering team has implemented mitigations and we’ve scheduled a targeted verification window.

What we’re doing:
• Enabling additional logging and targeted re-ingestion for affected batches.
• Running a verification sweep and sharing completion status.
• Offering a one-time pro-rata credit (equivalent to 1 day of usage) and an optional enablement session.

We will follow up with a summary and next steps by EOD local time. If you’d like a 1:1 troubleshooting session, reply and we’ll schedule.

Thanks for your patience — Marta, Customer Success
```

emily: For the troubleshoot session — can we run a short replay and collect logs from the affected accounts? I can run a demo at 10 SGT and capture sample traces. @sanjay can you enable increased retention for the ingestion pipeline?

sanjay: On it. I'll enable debug-level logs for the ingestion worker and extend retention to 48h for affected queues. ETA ~2h.

olivia: Timing looks good. Recommend piloting the outbound to 6 high-priority tenants first, confirm wording/response, then roll the rest. Also flag any enterprise accounts to renewals.

marta: Agreed. Pilot send 11:00 SGT, full send 14:00 SGT pending pilot status. Action owners: marta — send pilot and main outbound; aj — prepare credit CSV and billing labels; emily — run live session and collect traces; sanjay — enable logs; james-legal — finalize final sentence.

aj: :thumbsup: I’ll prepare the CSV and DM templates for CS reps.

marta: Final schedule: Troubleshoot session: Tomorrow 10:00 SGT (link: https://meet.google.com/abc-xyz). Pilot outbound 11:00 SGT (6 priority), full send 14:00 SGT. I’ll post final outbound in #customer-success 30m before pilot.

cs-bot: Calendar invite created for 'Tenant troubleshoot session' — attendees: @marta, @emily, @aj, @sanjay. Invite ID: invite-12345.

marta: Thanks team. Please escalate any reply with immediate impact to me and olivia. Will capture feedback and surface renewal risk if customers request credit beyond the offered amount.
